note: USACE Council Grove Lake campground on two points along the south shore; the lake-side sites in the northwest loop sit behind a strip of shoreline trees. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 50 A, water, reservable; fees $26-29 -> $22-29 (electric-only $22); count 33 -> 32 (excl. group); added pull-throughs, showers/flush/vault/dump, weekend 2-night minimum, 14-in-30 max. Lakeview confirmed (tree fringe on the shore).
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview) confirmed on imagery with catalog coordinates: rec.gov tags most sites 'Lakefront' (a claim). Northwest loop (018-032): the lake-side pads (025, 026, 028, 030, 031) are 20-35 m from the shoreline across a continuous strip of shoreline trees and a sand strip, so filtered views, not open ground. Southeast point (001-013): the gravel cul-de-sac sites 004-007 sit 10-20 m from a cove with a tree fringe along most of the shore; 010-013 sit above the cove behind trees. Canopy can't confirm open apron; lakeview stays. Possible lakefront lead only for 005/006 on the point tip, where an RV pad appears to sit at the cove's edge, but the edge is partly treed.

Count: rec.gov description says '35 reservable campsites, including one group camping area'; the catalog holds 31 standard electric sites, 1 tent-only (014) and the group area S-1 (16 group sites 'New for 2026' per its notice). Recorded 32 individual sites (31 RV).

Fees: stored low $26 is a template no site uses in 2026; the electric-only sites 015-017 are $22. Off-season: no rate after Oct 30 in the 2026-2028 tables (no walk-in season since 2021); season left unset (rate seasons are not a campground season).
Sewer: one site (023) has sewer; sites 001/002 carry notice 'This site no longer has sewer hookups available'. hookups.sewer not written (one site).

Phone 620-767-5195 confirmed (recreation.gov facility_phone). Pin 38.6845,-96.5264 is ~5 m from the all-site centroid 38.68450,-96.52637 (between the two loops, on the group area): fine. militaryDiscount rule present but not a discount claim; not written.
